PLAN "12-Week Bodyweight Strength Foundation"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build full-body strength using bodyweight only"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Upper Push Focus":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 3m
          arm_circles 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pike_push_up 3x5..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_dip 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          tricep_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Lower Body Strength":
        warmup:
          marching 2m
          leg_swings 1m
          hip_circles 1m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 1m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Upper Pull Focus":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 2m
          arm_circles 1m
          cat_cow 1m

There's no schema for meals, macros, calories, hydration, or supplementation, and inventing syntax for it would produce something the compiler will reject.

If you want, I can:

1. Extend the training programme (e.g. add a Phase 4 deload/retest, or accessory mobility days).
2. Adjust session volume/frequency to better support a specific nutrition goal you're handling separately (cut, lean gain, maintenance).
3. Add conditioning days sized for a calorie deficit, or reduce conditioning if he's eating in a surplus.

For the actual nutrition plan, you'll want to write that outside WPL-AI — it's out of scope for this DSL.

Which of the above would you like?
